PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: life drain
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: When a soul eater's soul saturation is low, they may drain this prisoner. Other prisoners who are soul eaters can also feed on this prisoner, if they are in the same cell.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: soul execution
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: Repeatedly extract soul fragments from this prisoner as a form of execution. Surgery will be automatically queued and performed by a doctor whenever possible.
